content:
Maggie Liu: quick check — final call on SDK/docs/sampleapps changelog cutoff for 0.9.2. Planning to lock tomorrow 9am PT. Anyone blocking?
Samir Patel: +1 for cutoff. SDK PR #487 is still awaiting one more review from @Alex Chen. I can ping infra for CI flakes but nothing functional.
Alex Chen: saw the ping, will review after stand. If tests pass I'll merge by EOD today.
Leo Nguyen: docs: we have 3 quickstart pages with outstanding TODOs (python auth example, webhooks section, and a small diagram). Targeting to finish by 6pm PT.
Maggie Liu: thanks. Which quickstart depends on sampleapp changes?
Leo Nguyen: sampleapp-node has a API surface change (constructor option: `enableStreaming`) that docs need to reference. Samir, is that landing?
Samir Patel: yes, added `enableStreaming` to node lib in feature branch. Currently behind one unit test and sampleapp usage.
Tia Ramos: sample apps: node & python both updated but python needs a minor pkg.json bump and a README snippet. I can cut that at lunch.
Alex Chen: quick question — does `enableStreaming` default to false? Need to be explicit in changelog and migration note.
Samir Patel: default false. Will add a line to the changelog entry: "Node SDK: new `enableStreaming` option (default: false) — opt-in streaming with shorter latencies."
Maggie Liu: good. Who's owning the changelog entry write-up?
Tia Ramos: I'll draft the sampleapp section and migration bullet. Leo can expand the quickstart code example.
Leo Nguyen: will update code snippets and the diagram reference. Also add the note about `enableStreaming` default.
Samir Patel: pinging @release-bot to create prerelease changelog draft.
release-bot: prerelease changelog draft created: https://internal/release/2012345678/draft — please add entries under your component tags.
Alex Chen: merging #487 now, will run a quick smoke on staging.
Maggie Liu: OK — plan for cutoff: lock merges at 9am PT tomorrow, start tagging at 9:15. If anything lands after 9am must have explicit :eyes: from me.
Tia Ramos: will post a short PR checklist in the draft changelog and update sampleapp READMEs.
Samir Patel: I'll add the SDK migration note and a code snippet in the changelog: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ enableStreaming: true });
client.generate(...).on('data', chunk => ...);
```
Leo Nguyen: docs snippet to match that.
Alex Chen: staging smoke passed for my changes. No regressions seen.
Maggie Liu: great — if nothing else, we'll call this green. Anyone with a blocker speak now or forever hold merge :)
Samir Patel: no blockers from infra side.
Tia Ramos: none here.
Leo Nguyen: done with docs edits, will push in ~45m.
Maggie Liu: thanks all — I'll lock changelog tomorrow morning and send release kickoff in #eng-releases. :party-parrot:
